Second transcription's note: The Form 8862 exceptions and the 2-year and 10-year bans cannot be decided from the supplied inputs, so a figured credit is refused when household.credit_disallowed is true. The option to have the IRS figure the credit (Step 6) is not modeled.

Second transcription's note: This line also carries Worksheet B line 11. Every earlier STOP has already made line 2 zero, so this line is zero in those cases.

Ruling: scope — i1040gi p. 46, Worksheet A, line 6 (and p. 48, Worksheet B, line 11). Both sides select line 2 when line 4 is Yes or line 3 is below the threshold and the smaller of lines 2 and 5 otherwise; all 2081 comparisons produce zero completed-return differences, and the 150 differences are on incomplete or refused records from scope-gate and question-order placement. Evidence: triage/eic.json, executable-triage-v2, 2081 comparisons, 1931 agreements; differences by return state {"incomplete": {"candidate-refuses": 1, "candidate-unknown": 36, "project-unknown": 48}, "refused": {"candidate-refuses": 38, "candidate-unknown": 19, "project-refuses": 1, "project-unknown": 7}}.

```yaml
lines:
  - id: eic.step5_line1
    printed: "(Step 5, 1)"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 1z."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line1z}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1]
    note: "The clergy and church-employee adjustments to this line are outside the tool and refused through scope.schedule1."
  - id: eic.step5_line2
    printed: "(Step 5, 2)"
    label: "Enter the Medicaid waiver payment amounts excluded from income on Schedule 1, line 8s, unless you choose to include these amounts in earned income, in which case enter -0-."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [scope.other_income, scope.schedule1]
    note: "Medicaid waiver payments are screened out, so only the zero case is computed."
  - id: eic.step5_line3
    printed: "(Step 5, 3)"
    label: "Subtract line 2 from line 1."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.step5_line1, take: eic.step5_line2}
  - id: eic.step5_line4
    printed: "(Step 5, 4)"
    label: "Enter all of your nontaxable combat pay if you elect to include it in earned income."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [s8812.combat_pay]
    note: "The closed interface has no combat pay election or amount. Any combat pay is refused, and only the zero case is computed."
  - id: eic.earned_income
    printed: "(Step 5, 5)"
    label: "Add lines 3 and 4. This is your earned income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.step5_line3, eic.step5_line4]}

  - id: eic.self_employed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 2: Were you self-employed at any time in 2025, or are you filing Schedule SE because you were a member of the clergy or you had church employee income, or are you filing Schedule C as a statutory employee?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: copy, from: s1.has_sc}
    note: "Read as having a Schedule C on the return. Clergy, church employee and statutory employee cases are screened out elsewhere."
  - id: eic.clergy
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 27b: minister, member of a religious order who has not taken a vow of poverty, or Christian Science practitioner filing Schedule SE, with Schedule SE line 2 including an amount also reported on line 1z."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [{const: true}, {const: false}]}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1]
    note: "Read as the line 27b box. Clergy income is refused through scope.schedule1, so the computed case is always false."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, lines 1a to 1c: Schedule SE, Part I, line 3 combined with lines 4b and 5a, for each person filing Schedule SE."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.se_line2, where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}}
    note: "Farm and Schedule K-1 amounts, optional methods (line 4b) and church employee income (line 5a) are screened out, so Schedule SE line 3 equals the Schedule C amount on line 2."
  - id: eic.h_wsb_1d
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, line 1d: Enter the amount from Schedule SE, Part I, line 13."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.se_line13, where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}}
  - id: eic.h_wsb_1e
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, line 1e: Subtract line 1d from line 1c."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.h_wsb_1c, take: eic.h_wsb_1d}
  - id: eic.h_wsb_2c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, lines 2a to 2c: net profit or (loss) from Schedule C, line 31, for self-employed persons not required to file Schedule SE."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.sc_total, where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: false}]}}
    note: "Farm and Schedule K-1 amounts are screened out, so line 2a is not computed."
  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_wsb_1e, eic.h_wsb_2c, eic.earned_income]}
    note: "Line 3, statutory employee income, is screened out and omitted. Line 4a is the Step 5 earned income."
  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: {const: 0}}
    note: "If line 4b is zero or less, the worksheet stops before this line, so the floor does not change any amount that is used."

  - id: eic.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero, used where no credit applies."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
  - id: eic.h_n_ssn
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs."
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: dependent, field: dependent.one, where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn_child, {const: true}]}}
  - id: eic.h_n_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of children who meet the conditions to be your qualifying child for the EIC, with or without a valid SSN."
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: dependent, field: dependent.one, where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}}

  - id: eic.h_l0o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$19,104"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.other}
  - id: eic.h_l0j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$26,214 if married filing jointly"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.joint}
  - id: eic.h_l1o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$50,434"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.other}
  - id: eic.h_l1j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$57,554 if married filing jointly"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.joint}
  - id: eic.h_l2o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$57,310"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.other}
  - id: eic.h_l2j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$64,430 if married filing jointly"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.joint}
  - id: eic.h_l3o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$61,555"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.other}
  - id: eic.h_l3j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$68,675 if married filing jointly"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.joint}
  - id: eic.h_limit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The income limit for your filing status and number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_l0o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_l0j}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_l1o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_l1j}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_l2o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_l2j}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_l3o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_l3j}

  - id: eic.h_s1q1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 1: Is the amount on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b, less than the limit?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_limit]}
  - id: eic.h_s1q2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 2: Do you, and your spouse if filing a joint return, have a social security number issued on or before the due date of your 2025 return (including extensions) that allows you to work and is valid for EIC purposes?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1q1, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: true}]}]}

    printed: "(helper)"

    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1 is passed: not filing Form 2555 and no nonresident alien spouse or filer."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1q2, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [eic.h_excluded_gate, scope.other_income]
    note: "sa.excluded_income also covers Form 4563 and Puerto Rico exclusions and does not isolate Form 2555. Those cases are refused when question 3 is reached rather than given a zero credit. Nonresident alien status is refused through scope.other_income."

  - id: eic.h_line7a_floor
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2: Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a. If line 7a is a loss, enter -0-."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f1040.line7a, take: {const: 0}}
  - id: eic.h_investment
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2: Add the amounts from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, lines 2a, 2b, 3b and 7a. Investment income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f1040.line2a, f1040.line2b, f1040.line3b, eic.h_line7a_floor]}
  - id: eic.h_s2_pass
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2 is passed: investment income is not more than $11,950, and none of the question 3 or 4 situations applies."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1_pass, {const: true}]}, {op: test, le: [eic.h_investment, {param: eic.investment_limit}]}]}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1, scope.other_line16, scope.other_income, sd.other_forms]
    note: "Form 4797, Schedule E, rental of personal property, Form 8814 and passive activity cases lead to Pub. 596 Worksheet 1 and are refused. With those excluded, investment income over the limit leads to the question 3 STOP."

        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "hoh"}]}, {op: test, eq: [household.married, {const: true}]}]}

    label: "Step 3, questions 4 and 5: same principal residence for the last 6 months of 2025, and not legally separated and living apart at the end of 2025."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: false}]}
  - id: eic.h_s3_q6_reach
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, question 6 is reached."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s2_pass, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_child, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_q5_fail, {const: false}]}
  - id: eic.h_s3_q6_fail
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, question 6: Could you be a qualifying child of another person for 2025? Yes: STOP."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_q6_reach, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}]}
  - id: eic.separated_box
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box in the Dependents section that discusses the special rule for separated spouses on page 1 of Form 1040 or 1040-SR."
    type: Bool
    expr:

      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_q6_reach, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
    note: "The flowchart attaches this box to every 'No' at question 6. The definition limits the rule to married filers not filing jointly, so the box is checked only for filers who answered 'Yes' at question 3."
  - id: eic.h_s3_pass
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 leads to Step 5 with a qualifying child."
    type: Bool
    expr:

      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s2_pass, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_child, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_q6_reach, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_s4_q2_reach
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 2 is reached: no qualifying child, and not a married taxpayer filing separately or as head of household."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s2_pass, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_child, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
  - id: eic.h_died_gate
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "If your spouse died in 2025 or if you are preparing a return for someone who died in 2025, see Pub. 596 before you answer."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_q2_reach, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.died_2025, {const: true}]}]}
  - id: eic.h_age_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of persons on the return born after December 31, 1960, and before January 2, 2001."
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [person.born_before_2001, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [person.born_after_1960, {const: true}]}]}
  - id: eic.h_s4_q2_pass
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 2: Were you, or your spouse if filing a joint return, at least age 25 but under age 65 at the end of 2025?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_q2_reach, {const: true}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_age_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
    refuses: [eic.h_died_gate]
    note: "A death in 2025 requires Pub. 596, so eic.died_2025 refuses through a gate only when this question is reached."
  - id: eic.h_s4_q3_fail
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 3: main home not in the United States for more than half of 2025. STOP."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_q2_pass, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: false}]}]}
  - id: eic.h_s4_q5_fail
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 5: Could you be a qualifying child of another person for 2025? Yes: STOP."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_q2_pass, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
  - id: eic.h_s4_pass
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4 leads to Step 5 without a qualifying child."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_q2_pass, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}]}
    note: "Question 6 uses sa.dependent, whose wording has the same exception for a person not required to file. It also covers a spouse and dual-status aliens. A spouse does not matter here because joint filers skip question 6, and nonresident status is already refused."
  - id: eic.h_s34_pass
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 or Step 4 leads to Step 5."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, any: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_pass, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_pass, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B: line 4b is more than zero and less than the limit on line 5."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}]}
  - id: eic.h_wsb_fail
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B: line 4b is zero or less, or is not less than the limit. STOP."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_pass, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_ok, {const: false}]}
  - id: eic.h_to_worksheet
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The filer reaches the credit lookup on Worksheet A or the lookup at Worksheet B, line 7."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_pass, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_ok, {const: true}]}]}
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: false}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}]}

  - id: eic.line1
    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5."
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: false}]}, then: eic.earned_income}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: true}]}, then: eic.wsb_6}
    note: "Only one set of lines is requested. Worksheet B lines 6 to 11 repeat Worksheet A lines 1 to 6, so this line carries Worksheet B line 6 for a filer who answered 'Yes' to Step 5, question 2."
  - id: eic.h_below_table
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "No lookup applies: the filer stopped earlier, or line 1 is below the first EIC Table row, which starts at $1."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_to_worksheet, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
  - id: eic.h_t0_l1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for the amount on line 1, no qualifying children."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t1_l1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for the amount on line 1, one qualifying child."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t2_l1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for the amount on line 1, two qualifying children."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t3_l1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for the amount on line 1, three or more qualifying children."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_below_table, {const: true}]}, then: eic.h_zero}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_below_table, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}, then: eic.h_t0_l1}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_below_table, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}, then: eic.h_t1_l1}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_below_table, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}, then: eic.h_t2_l1}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_below_table, {const: false}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}, then: eic.h_t3_l1}
    note: "The table has no row below $1, so an amount below $1 is read as a credit of zero. A filer stopped by an earlier step also gets zero here, which carries the STOP to the credit."
  - id: eic.h_line2_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "If line 2 is zero, STOP. You can't take the credit."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_to_worksheet, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}]}
  - id: eic.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line11b}
  - id: eic.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.line1]}

  - id: eic.h_w0o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$10,620"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.other}
  - id: eic.h_w0j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$17,730 if married filing jointly"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.joint}
  - id: eic.h_w1o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$23,350"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.other}
  - id: eic.h_w1j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$30,470 if married filing jointly"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.joint}
  - id: eic.h_threshold
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold for your filing status and number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_w0o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_w0j}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_w1o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}, then: eic.h_w1j}
  - id: eic.h_l5_used
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 is completed: line 2 is not zero, line 4 is No, and line 3 is not less than the threshold."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_to_worksheet, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_threshold]}
  - id: eic.h_t0_l3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for the amount on line 3, no qualifying children."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t1_l3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for the amount on line 3, one qualifying child."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t2_l3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for the amount on line 3, two qualifying children."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t3_l3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for the amount on line 3, three or more qualifying children."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "If line 3 is not less than the threshold, look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l5_used, {const: false}]}, then: eic.h_zero}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l5_used, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}, then: eic.h_t0_l3}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l5_used, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}, then: eic.h_t1_l3}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l5_used, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}, then: eic.h_t2_l3}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l5_used, {const: true}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}, then: eic.h_t3_l3}
    note: "A line left blank is represented as zero. Line 6 reads this line only when eic.h_l5_used is true."
  - id: eic.h_smaller
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look at the amounts on lines 5 and 2. Then, enter the smaller amount on line 6."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.line2]}
  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l5_used, {const: true}]}, then: eic.h_smaller}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l5_used, {const: false}]}, then: eic.line2}
    note: "This line also carries Worksheet B line 11. Every earlier STOP has already made line 2 zero, so this line is zero in those cases."

  - id: eic.h_8862_gate
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A credit is figured, and your EIC for a year after 1996 was reduced or disallowed. See Form 8862, who must file."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, gt: [eic.line6, {const: 0}]}, {op: test, eq: [household.credit_disallowed, {const: true}]}]}
  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Enter this amount on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 27a."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.line6}
    refuses: [eic.h_8862_gate]
    note: "The Form 8862 exceptions and the 2-year and 10-year bans cannot be decided from the supplied inputs, so a figured credit is refused when household.credit_disallowed is true. The option to have the IRS figure the credit (Step 6) is not modeled."
  - id: eic.check_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on line 27c if you have been instructed to check the box in the instructions for line 27a."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1q1, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: false}]}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_q6_fail, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_q3_fail, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s4_q5_fail, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_fail, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_line2_zero, {const: true}]}
    note: "Covers only the STOPs that say to check line 27c. The closed interface has no input for choosing not to claim the credit, so that part of line 27c is not modeled. The nonresident alien instruction is refused earlier."
```
